ceiling_statement: The maximum feasible evolvability guarantee is ratchet-monotonicity over a committed floor set: every admitted evolution step S_n -> S_(n+1) carries a certificate that (1) recomputes (never trusts) the committed capability-floor vector Floors(S_n) from the previous release's hash-chained census, (2) proves pointwise measure(S_(n+1), c) >= measure(S_n, c) for every committed floor c, (3) proves Floors(S_n) ⊆ Floors(S_(n+1)) (the set of measured capabilities itself only grows), and (4) fail-closed refuses any step whose floor preservation cannot be established (H3/H7). Monotonicity over UNMEASURED capabilities is unattainable by any feasible system; the ceiling is exactly non-regression on executable, committed measures, with the measure set monotone.
derivation: Computability: 'S_(n+1) is at least as capable as S_n' over all semantic capabilities is a non-trivial semantic property of programs, undecidable by Rice; a decidable admission gate therefore exists only for capabilities reduced to executable measures (tests, gate counts, proof obligations discharged) fixed BEFORE the comparison. Storage/consistency: the floor vector of S_n must be bound into an append-only hash chain (the same physics as anti-rollback: a floor drop must be a detectable chain break, not an overwritable claim), otherwise a producer could lower a floor and re-declare it — violating H8's zero-producer-trust. Trade-off limit (CAP-flavored): unrestricted evolution and guaranteed invariant preservation are jointly unsatisfiable; the only consistent resolution under H3 is to block every step not provably floor-preserving, i.e., the gate sacrifices evolution-liveness, never invariant-safety. Nothing feasible exceeds recompute-and-compare ratcheting over committed measures.
attainment_mechanism: Buildable now: B0 already has the ratchet skeleton — systems/orchestrator-cli/capability-gate.lisp (monotonic capability ratchet with dataset-stamp), systems/orchestrator-cli/architecture-gate.lisp (ontological-closure map≡implementation gate), retired-entrypoint tombstones (systems/orchestrator-spec/conditions.lisp + tests/retired-entrypoint-test.lisp — capability removal is a permanent tombstone, not a silent drop), and drift gates (tests/dependency-contract-consistency-test.lisp). Ceiling attainment: serialize the full floor vector (gate list, proof-manifest counts from authority-v2/proofs/verify-proof-manifest.py, mutation-kill totals, LEVEL7 matrix rows from authority-v2/LEVEL7-COMPLETION-MATRIX.sexp) into the census systems/orchestrator-epistemic/artifact-census.lisp, chained by prev_release_root (SHA-256, already the mechanism of AX-08); the admission step recomputes S_n's floors from the chain, recomputes S_(n+1)'s floors from the candidate tree, compares pointwise, and emits an all-or-nothing transition certificate per authority-v2/schema/transition-certificate.cddl. All of this is SBCL + SHA-256 + existing gates; no new theory needed.
b0_gap: Map row AX-20 + §3: (1) the ratchet is a FAMILY of reactive point-gates each added after a found defect, not one global monotonicity theorem — a capability with no point-gate has no floor; (2) the floor vector is not today bound into the signed release chain, so a floor drop is a test failure at best, not a cryptographically detectable chain break (producer trust remains, violating the H8-grade ceiling); (3) the ASDF layer graph is not machine-verified (17 .asd files, 3 coexisting version numbers per the map) so 'the architecture only grows consistently' is unenforced at the system-composition level; (4) the kernel's monotonic-sequence conjunct in authority-v2/kernel/admission-model.sexp is stated but unproved (0/17).
lean_obligation: Model releases as a chain R : Nat -> Release with hash-links link : forall n, R(n+1).prev = H(R n), a committed floor map Floors : Release -> Finset Cap, and measures mu : Release -> Cap -> Nat. Prove: theorem ratchet : (forall n, Admit (R n) (R (n+1)) -> (Floors (R n) ⊆ Floors (R (n+1))) ∧ (forall c ∈ Floors (R n), mu (R (n+1)) c >= mu (R n) c)) ∧ (forall n cand, ¬ Decidable_floor_preserving (R n) cand -> ¬ Admit (R n) cand), and corollary chain_monotone : forall m n, m <= n -> forall c ∈ Floors (R m), mu (R n) c >= mu (R m) c (floors never decay across any distance), plus tamper-evidence: any R' with a lowered floor and valid links contradicts collision-resistance of H.
